status: written after design-only counts (sizes.py, curated_pairs.py: instance counts and class sizes, no vector read, no statistic computed) and before any vector-derived number
amendments: 2026-11-13T02:40Z, before any vector-derived number (prep job 88061 pending): background candidates H need coverage >= 0.8 of the instance genomes when >= 10 such families exist, otherwise >= 0.5 (broadly distributed pairs such as the A-B-C operon span 7 phyla, where few families reach 0.8); each d_H is paired on its own common subset I_H (>= 10 instances), so coverage changes only how many instances a background uses. Same-component curated pairs (two HsdR etc.) are excluded from class b.

inputs.vectors: ESM++ small residue means (embed_queue run dpann__esmpp_small__20261111, final/mean_raw_f32__uid.npy, uid_of_row.npy = gid -> uid), zca10 transform exactly as softrec/embed_tokens.py (unit, count-weighted centring, soft-ZCA alpha 0.1 on the count-weighted covariance, unit)
inputs.genome_groups: lineagefree groups: emb_hom_average_t0.75 (642 groups, primary permutation unit), fam_jac_average_t0.2 (232 groups, primary label set for signal 2 and secondary permutation unit), emb_mean_average_t0.753 (species-scale, used only as a partialling covariate)
inputs.taxonomy: GTDB r232 phylum / order from genomes.parquet: evaluation labels only

definitions.eligible_gene: its rescue3 family has >= 3 distinct uids
definitions.family_centred_residual: r_i = x_i - c_F^(-i), c_F^(-i) = mean of the family's distinct-uid vectors excluding the gene's own uid
definitions.genome_background: b_g = mean of r over the genome's eligible genes; used leave-one-out (b_g^(-i), and leave-two-out for an instance pair)

signal1_partner_covariation.hypothesis: for co-located family pairs, the way one member deviates from its family centre predicts the way its partner deviates, beyond shared ancestry (genome similarity), genome background and the covariation the same family shows with families far away in the same genomes
signal1_partner_covariation.instances: family pair (F, G) unordered; two genes at offset 1..3 on one contig; one instance per genome (closest pair, ties lowest gid); then one per distinct (uid_F, uid_G); n = distinct instances; capped at 400 by random subsample (seed 17)
signal1_partner_covariation.statistic_M: partial Spearman correlation over the n(n-1)/2 instance pairs between cos(e_F,i, e_F,j) and cos(e_G,i, e_G,j), partialling [rank S, rank S^2, rank S^3, same emb_mean-0.753 group, same fam_jac-0.2 group], S = emb_mean similarity of the two instance genomes
signal1_partner_covariation.background_excess_E: side F: candidate families H with an eligible gene in >= 80% of the instance genomes, every used H gene >= 20 genes from both instance genes or on another contig, one H gene per genome (lowest gid); from <= 60 random candidates keep the 10 whose tree-likeness rho(C_H, S) is closest to rho(C_G, S); for each H, on the common instances I_H (>= 0.8 n and >= 10): d_H = M(F,G | I_H) - M(F,H | I_H). Side G symmetric with H' replacing F. E = mean of all d_H; requires >= 3 backgrounds on each side, else E undefined
signal1_partner_covariation.permutation_null: rows of G permuted within emb_hom 0.75 groups, 199 permutations, p = (1 + #{M_perm >= M}) / 200; secondary within fam_jac 0.2 groups
signal1_partner_covariation.minimum_n: existence test n >= 30; co-fold and curated tests n >= 10 primary, n >= 30 secondary (counts before any statistic: screen-1 cognate folds with n >= 10: 158 folds / 79 family pairs / 28 hits; uncalled 10 / 9 / 1; curated positives 42 / 27 / 18; at n >= 30: 62 / 31 / 12, 1 / 1 / 1, 18 / 10 / 9)

existence_test.strata: family pairs with n >= 30: S_op = engine-called, majority of instances offset 1 and same strand, median intergenic gap <= 50 nt; S_opp = majority of instances offset 1 on opposite strands (any engine status); S_unc = engine-uncalled, majority offset 1 same strand; up to 1,000 random pairs per stratum (seed 17)
existence_test.criterion_exists: median E in S_op > 0 with bootstrap (family pairs, 2,000 draws, seed 17) interval excluding 0, and the fraction of S_op pairs with p_perm <= 0.05 >= 0.10
existence_test.criterion_beyond_linkage: median E(S_op) - median E(S_opp) > 0 with interval excluding 0 (adjacent but opposite-strand pairs are co-inherited as often and rarely interact)
existence_test.refuted_if: median E in S_op has an interval including 0, or p_perm in S_op is uniform (fraction <= 0.05 below 0.10)

usable_a_cofold.set: screen-1 folded pairs (grammar/prep/folded.parquet, cognate + uncalled), hit = ipTM >= 0.75, restricted to folds whose family pair has E defined at n >= 10; second set: screen-1 curated positives (150 folds) the same way; scores are per family pair, bootstrap resamples family pairs (2,000 draws, seed 17)
usable_a_cofold.comparators: engine -log P (folded.parquet eng_nlogP) and grammar critic s_primary (grammar/eval/folded_scored_cv.parquet) on the identical subset
usable_a_cofold.combination: mean of within-subset percentile ranks of E and engine -log P (no fitting)
usable_a_cofold.criterion_usable: AUROC(E) >= 0.60 with lower bound > 0.5, and AUROC(combination) - AUROC(engine) >= +0.03 with interval excluding 0

usable_b_curated.set: curated_pairs.parquet: complex = RM_Type_I (two different Hsd subunits), RM_Type_III Mod+Res, MazE+MazF, GajA+GajB, CRISPR two effector-complex subunits or two adaptation subunits; noncomplex = RM_Type_II REase+MTase, CRISPR adaptation x effector subunit; same-component pairs excluded; unit = token pair with n >= 10 (class sizes before statistics: complex 71, noncomplex 40); a token pair in both classes is dropped
usable_b_curated.criterion: AUROC(E, complex vs noncomplex) >= 0.65 with lower bound > 0.5; also within CRISPR and within RM (I+III vs II)

signal1_partner_covariation.worked_example_c: A-B (81718-393054, n 195), B-C (393054-130016, n 197), A-C (81718-130016, n 220): M, E, p_perm and the percentile of E among S_op pairs
signal1_partner_covariation.secondary_statistic: out-of-sample canonical correlation: genomes split by genome_code parity, PCA to k = min(10, n_train/5) per side fitted on the training half, first canonical pair fitted on the training half (ridge 0.1), Pearson of the canonical variates on the other half; reported, not used for verdicts

signal2_provenance.hypothesis: after removing the family centre, a gene's residual carries the compositional signature of the lineage it was encoded in; transferred blocks carry a donor signature that differs from the host's

test1_exists.model: multinomial logistic regression (linear softmax, torch CPU, weight decay 1e-4, 4 epochs, batch 4096, Adam lr 1e-3) from r_i to the genome's group; families split in two halves by token parity; trained on one half, scored on the other (cross-fit); training sample <= 1.2 M eligible genes per half (seed 17)
test1_exists.labels: fam_jac 0.2 groups (primary, taxonomy-free); GTDB phylum and order (evaluation)
test1_exists.controls: the same model on labels permuted across genomes (chance); the same model on the uncentred vector x (reference)
test1_exists.criterion: held-out-family top-1 accuracy lower bound >= 2x the majority-class rate, and held-out cross-entropy >= 0.25 bits below the prior entropy

test2_foreignness.score: f_i = -log2 p(host group | r_i) from the cross-fitted fam_jac-0.2 model (each gene scored by the model that never saw its family)
test2_foreignness.sets: DefenseFinder members; CRISPRCasTyper members; TXSScan members; genes carrying a transposase / integrase / recombinase Pfam domain (observed domains; regex on Pfam names: transpos|DDE_Tnp|rve|Phage_integrase|Recombinase|Resolvase|HTH_Tnp|Y1_Tnp|OrfB_|IS605); ribosomal Pfam marker genes (ribosomal/gold/marked.parquet; expected native, negative control)
test2_foreignness.comparison: difference of mean f against all eligible genes, raw and stratified (family distinct-uid bins 3-5/6-10/11-30/31-100/>100 x family genome-group breadth 1/2-3/4-10/>10 x residual-norm decile; stratum-weighted mean difference); even genomes primary
test2_foreignness.criterion: DefenseFinder stratified difference > 0 with interval excluding 0, and ribosomal stratified difference < 0 with interval excluding 0

test3_coherence.score: c_ij = cosine between centred host-relative log-probability vectors (log p(. | r_i) - mean over the genome's eligible genes, each centred over groups)
test3_coherence.decay: mean c at offsets 1, 2, 3, 5, 10, 20, 50 on one contig and for pairs on different contigs of one genome (random 1 M pairs)
test3_coherence.criterion_exists: mean c(offset 1) - mean c(different contigs) > 0 with interval excluding 0
test3_coherence.criterion_loci: mean c over adjacent pairs of members of one curated instance - mean c over all adjacent pairs with the same strand configuration > 0 with interval excluding 0 (DefenseFinder primary)

test4_boundary.condition: run only if test2 or test3 criterion_loci holds; otherwise reported as exploratory
test4_boundary.boundaries: edge = between the first (last) member of a contiguous curated instance with >= 2 members and its outside neighbour that is in no instance; interior = between two consecutive member genes; random = adjacent pairs in the same genomes touching no member
test4_boundary.criterion: AUROC(edge vs interior) >= 0.60 with lower bound > 0.5 (DefenseFinder), even genomes
test4_boundary.adds_to_support: logistic regression edge vs interior on [log1p(boundary_support), c] fitted on odd genomes, scored on even; adds if AUROC(model) - AUROC(support alone, same fit) >= +0.02 with interval excluding 0

expectations_written_before_numbers.s1_exists: E > 0 on average in S_op but small (median E about +0.02 to +0.05); E(S_op) - E(S_opp) near 0, because most of any excess is co-inheritance of linked genes, not interaction; permutation p-values only modestly enriched
expectations_written_before_numbers.s1_cofold: AUROC(E) 0.50-0.60, below the engine, no gain from the combination
expectations_written_before_numbers.s1_curated: no separation (AUROC 0.45-0.60): RM Type II REase and MTase co-evolve in specificity without a complex
expectations_written_before_numbers.s1_abc: B-C and A-B positive E, p_perm < 0.05 at n about 200; A-C weaker
expectations_written_before_numbers.s2_exists: strong: phylum accuracy far above the 0.49 majority rate; fam_jac group top-1 well above the majority rate
expectations_written_before_numbers.s2_foreignness: DefenseFinder and transposase-domain genes above background, ribosomal markers below, both modest after stratification
expectations_written_before_numbers.s2_coherence: small positive decay with distance; higher inside defence loci
